03 - [BUG] Verify the top utility bar shows Chat, Language switcher, and Product Comparison links
CONFIRMED REAL DEFECT (found during 2026-08-03 reconciliation) — the Chat entry point in the top utility bar is not reliably visible at the 1366px desktop breakpoint. On different page loads it resolves to either a.yamaha-chat-link (present in the DOM with the correct href, but computed-hidden — Playwright's own actionability check confirmed "locator resolved to hidden" across 34 retries over 15s) or a second, differently-classed element (.yamaha-mobile-menu-utility--chat) that is also 0x0 / offsetParent:null at desktop width. Language switcher and Product Comparison links are unaffected. A real desktop user cannot reliably see or click the Chat link from the header.
Failed ▼
syncing…
# Action Expected / Result Status
#01 Verify visible: css=a.yamaha-chat-link, css=.switcher-language, css=a.action.compare
⚠ Errorlocator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded. Call log: [2m - waiting for locator('a.yamaha-chat-link').first() to be visible[22m [2m 34 × locator resolved to hidden <a aria-label="Chat" class="yamaha-chat-link" href="https://yamaha-id-m248-ce-txq.kemana.dev/livechat/index/index/">Chat</a>[22m
🖼️ Live Page Screenshot — the actual front-end element click to zoom
🔍 Element Inspector · <a> verify_visible click to zoom
🔍 Root Cause
[A] WEBSITE BEHAVIOUR vs DESIGN CONFLICT — the desktop "Chat" link is not in the server-rendered HTML at all. It is injected client-side by the Kemana live-chat module (customer-data section kemana-livechat, loaded alongside kemana-dealer-selection) and written with an inline style="display: none;". The requirements sheet scopes Live Chat to "PDP once dealer selected", so the module most likely hides the link on purpose until a dealer is chosen — but Figma's Homepage frame shows "Chat" permanently in the top utility bar. Language switcher and Product Comparison links render correctly.
❌ Problematic Code
<!-- live DOM, top utility bar (injected by kemana-livechat JS) -->
<a class="yamaha-chat-link" aria-label="Chat"
   href="https://yamaha-id-m248-ce-txq.kemana.dev/livechat/index/index/"
   style="display: none;">Chat</a>
✅ Fixed Code
<!-- if Chat must always show on desktop, per Figma -->
<a class="yamaha-chat-link" aria-label="Chat"
   href="https://yamaha-id-m248-ce-txq.kemana.dev/livechat/index/index/">Chat</a>
// kemana-livechat component: only hide the link when chat is genuinely
// unavailable, instead of whenever no dealer is selected
if (!livechatConfig.enabled) { $chatLink.hide(); }
📋 What To Do
Confirm with the client which source wins: Figma (Chat always visible in the header) or the requirements sheet (chat only after a dealer is selected on the PDP). If the requirement wins, mark this test as by-design and drop the Chat check from it; if Figma wins, remove the inline display:none logic for the header link in the kemana-livechat module.

12 - Verify hovering a different category tab (Matic) switches the active category and updates the product carousel
RECLASSIFIED 2026-10-01 — previously logged as a confirmed defect (2026-08-03), but re-investigated live and it is a TEST TIMING issue, not a site bug. Hovering "Produk" right after DOMContentLoaded (before the mega-menu JS has initialised) does nothing — in 2 of 3 cold tries the menu never opened. After the page's widgets have initialised, hovering Matic switched the active tab to "Matic" 3/3 times. A real shopper moves the mouse continuously, so the menu opens on their next mouse move — no user impact. Now waits for the RequireJS widget-init marker (the minicart dialog, same one test 33 uses) and for the opened menu (.yamaha-mega-menu.active — a hidden second copy exists) first. Second, bigger cause: the runner's hover action always moved the mouse to the page corner (5,5) before hovering, which left the "Produk" menu and closed it, so the Matic tab was hidden by the time it was hovered. The Matic hover now uses keep_pointer: true (moves straight from "Produk" into the menu, like a real user).

Call log: [2m - waiting for locator('//ul[@data-role=\'yamaha-search-popular\']//button[not(contains(\'|NMAX|XMAX|TMAX|AEROX|LEXI|FAZZIO|FILANO|GRAND FILANO|FREEGO|GEAR|MIO|X-RIDE|JUPITER|VIXION|MT15|MT25|R15|R25|XSR|WR|MX KING|\', concat(\'|\', translate(normalize-space(),\'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\',\'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ\'), \'|\')))]').first() to be hidden[22m [2m 24 × locator resolved to visible <button type="button" data-search-term="a">a</button>[22m
🖼️ Live Page Screenshot — the actual front-end element click to zoom
🔍 Element Inspector · <button> verify_not_visible click to zoom
🔍 Root Cause
[A] WEBSITE BUG (content/config) — "Pencarian Populer" is fed by Magento's native search-term popularity (the search_query table: terms ranked by how often visitors searched them), not by a curated list. On this staging site the most-searched terms are QA/test inputs, so the list shows junk like "red", "max", "relax" (it showed "a", "nmax", "xmax" earlier the same day — the list changes as people search). Figma specifies real model names ("NMAX", "Fazzio", "Aerox").
❌ Problematic Code
<ul class="yamaha-search-popular" data-role="yamaha-search-popular">
  <li><button type="button" data-search-term="red">red</button></li>
  <li><button type="button" data-search-term="max">max</button></li>
  <li><button type="button" data-search-term="relax">relax</button></li>
</ul>
✅ Fixed Code
<ul class="yamaha-search-popular" data-role="yamaha-search-popular">
  <li><button type="button" data-search-term="NMAX">NMAX</button></li>
  <li><button type="button" data-search-term="Fazzio">Fazzio</button></li>
  <li><button type="button" data-search-term="Aerox">Aerox</button></li>
</ul>
📋 What To Do
Either (a) clean up Admin > Marketing > SEO & Search > Search Terms (delete test/junk terms, and exclude them from "popular"), or better (b) make the popular-search block read a curated, admin-configurable list of model names instead of raw search popularity, so test traffic can never surface on the storefront again. Re-check before go-live — raw popularity will keep drifting.

🔍 Root Cause
[A] WEBSITE BUG (tablet breakpoint) — at tablet widths (768-1024px) the header cart icon is visible, and Magento's minicart widget intercepts the tap (so the /checkout/cart/ link is NOT followed), but the dropdown dialog it opens never becomes visible: its wrapper stays display: none and renders at 0x0. Net result: tapping the cart does nothing. On desktop the same widget opens the dropdown correctly; on mobile (390px) a separate bottom-bar cart link works.
